posts.text: Big win in Wisconsin. Was proud to endorse and support another great Chris.

No President in control of his senses would publicly promise to eradicate an entire civilization.

That's why I agree with Republicans who have put the 25th Amendment on the table. Trump seems to be taking us on a path to mass war crimes. That's a path we cannot accept.

Video

Even if Iran reopens the Strait, how is that a "good outcome"? The region is on fire. The global economy is going to take a year or more to recover. An anti-American regime is in power and emboldened. Iran still has their missiles and nuclear program. That's "good"?


Brett McGurk (@brett_mcgurk)

This sets a precondition—

“The Islamic Republic of Iran agreeing to the complete, immediate, and safe reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.”

If met, that’s a good outcome.





— https://nitter.net/bret

Iran says the U.S. has agreed to their 10 point plan, which gives them control of the Strait, lets them keep their nuclear program and also their missiles, and drops sanctions against Iran.

If this isn't true - and let's hope it's not - it is proof that there is indeed no deal.


Faytuks News (@Faytuks)

Iran's Supreme National Security Council calls this a "crushing defeat" for the US, saying that they've been forced to accept their 10-point plan.

Iran claims the US has agreed to continued Ir

It appears Trump just agreed to give Iran control of the Strait of Hormuz, a history-changing win for Iran.

The level of incompetence is both stunning and heartbreaking.

What on earth is happening?
I will be on @CNN in a few minutes to talk about our completely unhinged President and a war that is spiraling fast out of control.

Also Congress could just vote to stop him. Your party could simply choose to not have America commit war crimes.


Former Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene🇺🇸 (@FmrRepMTG)

25TH AMENDMENT!!!
Not a single bomb has dropped on America. We cannot kill an entire civilization. 
This is evil and madness.





— https://nitter.net/FmrRepMTG/status/2041499550012084690#m
Feels like as the Iran War spirals out of control and DHS remains shut down, Republican leaders in Congress should call us back into session. But they won’t.

In an age of creeping relativism, a universal moral law still exists. 

Threatening to end an entire civilization of 90 million people in order to bend a nation’s conduct to your will is grossly morally wrong. It is evil. And we should say this loudly.

Video
